groupshared float16_t gs_tmp[512];
groupshared float16_t gs_attn[256];

float round_h(float x)
{
    return (float)((float16_t)x);
}

uint token_base_index(uint win, uint tok)
{
    uint wy = win / NW;
    uint wx = win - wy * NW;
    uint ly = tok >> 2;
    uint lx = tok & 3;
    uint y = wy * 4 + ly;
    uint x = wx * 4 + lx;
    return (y * W_SIZE + x) * C_SIZE;
}

float gelu_approx(float x)
{
    const float k0 = 0.7978845608028654f;
    const float k1 = 0.044715f;
    float x2 = x * x;
    return 0.5f * x * (1.0f + tanh(k0 * (x + k1 * x * x2)));
}

    {

        float sum = WaveActiveSum(x);
        float mean = sum * (1.0f / 32.0f);

        float vsum = WaveActiveSum(d * d);
        float inv_std = rsqrt(vsum * (1.0f / 32.0f) + 1.0e-5f);

        nv = nv * (float)state_1[lane] + (float)state_2[lane];
        gs_tmp[tok0 * C_SIZE + lane] = (float16_t)nv;

        uint tok = item / 96;
        uint base = tok * C_SIZE;

        float prod = (float)gs_tmp[base + lane] * (float)state_3[o * C_SIZE + lane];
        float acc = WaveActiveSum(prod);

                s = round_h(s);
